description: This file contains utility functions for proxying requests within the Kubernetes API server, including resolving service endpoints, cluster URLs, and creating proxied requests with context and audit propagation.

methods.name: findServicePort
methods.description: Finds a service port by name or number within a given Service object.

methods.name: ResolveEndpoint
methods.description: Returns a URL for sending traffic to a specified service and port, handling dual-stack and endpoint selection.

methods.name: ResolveCluster
methods.description: Returns a URL for accessing a service via its ClusterIP or ExternalName.

methods.name: NewRequestForProxy
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP request for proxying, with context timeout for discovery requests and propagation of audit ID.
